title: WEIR: Watershed Exploration and Drift-Aware Prefix Shrinkage for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: WEIR：面向多轮智能体强化学习的分水岭探索与漂移感知前缀收缩
abstract_en: Multi-turn language model agents often receive only a single binary reward at the end of a long interaction trajectory, making it difficult to separate decisive decisions from routine steps or estimate accurate intermediate values. Prefix-tree methods improve sample efficiency by merging trajectories that share action histories, yet two structural flaws remain: naive pooling mixes stale off-policy outcomes into critic targets with fixed weights, and uniform or entropy-driven branching wastes continuations on dead-end states whose outcome is already settled. We introduce WEIR (Watershed Exploration and Intrinsic-Drift Shrinkage), an actor-critic reinforcement learning framework grounded in a Doob turn-variance conservation identity. WEIR maintains a cross-iteration canonical action-prefix tree with exponentially discounted visit counts and trains a prefix-conditioned critic toward a minimax drift-aware shrinkage target that adapts from single-trajectory returns at rare nodes to pooled empirical means at dense nodes. Using the same pre-update critic, WEIR allocates rollout budgets across tasks via Neyman stratification $B_q \propto \sqrt{\hat{p}_q(1-\hat{p}_q)}$ and directs within-task branches to watershed forks where high survival-headroom uncertainty coincides with steep value cliffs. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, ALFWorld, and WebShop on Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct, WEIR achieves $32.18\%$ and $37.85\%$ average QA exact match and $84.83\%$ and $87.81\%$ ALFWorld success rates, outperforming CAPO by $1.50$--$3.74$ points while generating $28$--$29\%$ fewer rollout tokens than chain sampling.
abstract_zh: 多轮语言模型智能体通常只在长交互轨迹结束时获得一个二元奖励，难以识别哪些决策左右了结果，也难以准确估计中间状态的价值。前缀树可以复用共享动作历史的轨迹，但固定权重汇总会让过时的离策略回报影响价值估计，而均匀或基于熵的分支策略会在结局已基本确定的状态上浪费采样预算。WEIR 是一种基于 Doob 逐轮方差守恒恒等式的 actor–critic 框架。它跨训练迭代维护统一的动作前缀树，对访问计数施加指数衰减，并以漂移感知的极小极大收缩目标训练以动作前缀为条件的 critic：访问稀少时偏重单条轨迹回报，访问密集时偏重汇总经验均值。WEIR 还使用同一个更新前的 critic，通过 Neyman 分层分配在任务间分配采样预算，并在任务内优先探索成功前景仍不确定且价值变化陡峭的分叉点。实验覆盖四个多跳问答基准、ALFWorld 和 WebShop。Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的平均问答精确匹配率分别为 32.18% 和 37.85%，ALFWorld 成功率分别为 84.83% 和 87.81%；相较 CAPO 提升 1.50–3.74 个百分点，相较链式采样少生成 28%–29% 的 rollout token。
key_points_zh: 跨迭代复用共享动作前缀，并对访问计数做指数衰减，以降低陈旧样本的影响。
漂移感知收缩目标在稀疏节点偏重单轨迹回报，在密集节点偏重汇总均值。
任务间按估计成功率方差的平方根分配预算；任务内优先探索成功前景不明且价值陡变的分叉。
相较 CAPO 提升 1.50–3.74 个百分点；相较链式采样减少 28%–29% 的 rollout token。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是利用多轮文本代理的轨迹与终局反馈更新策略：通过跨迭代前缀树修正价值目标，并据此分配采样预算。摘要报告了基线比较和采样开销，但未给出足以复现的细节，也未展示各组件的独立效果。
